description: Performance and Sustainability Oriented Framework for Collective Agreements in State-Owned Enterprises
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-10-26 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been decided at the Cabinet meeting held on 2026-05-11 to extend the existing Collective Agreements in State-Owned Enterprises under their current terms and conditions until 2026-12-31, to develop a new, revised framework to be effective from 2027-01-01 and to appoint an Expert Committee to review the existing Collective Agreement Mechanism and formulate the said revised framework. Accordingly, the Secretary to the Treasury has appointed an Expert Committee, and the said Committee in consultation with the relevant parties as well, has submitted a Report titled 'Performance and Sustainability Oriented Framework for Collective Agreements in State-Owned Enterprises' The Report has made recommendations regarding the implementation of Collective Agreements in State-Owned Enterprises in compliance with the Industrial Disputes Act, the Trade Unions Ordinance, the Shop and Office Employees laws, and other relevant labour laws and made recommendations regarding a framework for profit-sharing and bonuses. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to implement the new policy framework applicable to the Collective Agreement Mechanism in State-Owned Enterprises, with effect from January 2027-01-01, was approved by the Cabinet.
